title: Beryllium carbonate: a model compound for highest capacity carbon sequestration chemistry
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,40133-40140
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07753A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gad Licht, Kyle Hofstetter, Stuart Licht
Beryllium carbonate is introduced as a model compound, establishing a baseline among the highest CO2 capture capacities. The stepwise mechanism of beryllium carbonate's CO2 release is determined.
